title: Haste Spore Grenade

sources.title: Sublimate of Haste Spores
markers: | description = '''Sublimate of Haste Spores''' is an [[Alchemy|Alchemical Extraction]]. It can be combined with any [[Alchemy#Extractions|Essence]] to create a {{SmRarityItem|Haste Spore Grenade}}.

summary: Throw as an Action to make a 7 ft radius Haste Spores cloud for 3 turns.

fields.Throw: Single use, up to 60 ft. Entering applies a 1-turn buff confirmed in Honour Mode. Leave and re-enter to refresh while the cloud lasts.
fields.Haste Spores: Any affected creature gets +2 AC, advantage on Dexterity saves, +30 ft movement and an extra Action, without Lethargic afterward. In Honour Mode the extra Action does not support Extra Attack and Slowed can remove the effect.
fields.Crafting: Three Hastening Spores make Sublimate of Haste Spores. Combine it with any Essence. Spaw can also give it if the party immediately accepts the first offer to eliminate the duergar.
fields.Base value: 25 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
